case_number: 2025 INSC 63; CONTEMPT PETITION (C) NO. 735 OF 2019; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2703 OF 2017
summary: Contempt for non-compliance with salary payment order; petitioner No. 1's claim for arrears from absorption to state bifurcation pending; State of Jharkhand paid post-bifurcation arrears; discrepancies in attendance found; no willful non-compliance established; claim for arrears and pension to be adjudicated afresh by Registrar/Vice Chancellor; directions issued for fresh enquiry with opportunity to be heard; pension decision to disregard prior contempt orders; appeal disposed of with directions.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Bihar & others vs Bihar Rajya M.S.E.S.K.K.M & others (2005) 9 SCC 129
final_judgment: Contempt petition disposed of with directions for adjudication of arrears and pension by Registrar/Vice Chancellor; liberty to challenge before High Court.
